question: Vinay starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards North. He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns left and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Vinay starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards North.

He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns left and drives 11 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40e890b409bc9dde9b4d7aed230c5f8e564f22785f8050e0ef15bce61246d5e2.png] 

So, He should drive **2 km to west** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
